description: This file implements runtime detection and caching of capabilities for OpenRouter models, including disk and in-memory caching, API fetching, and capability parsing.

methods.name: ensureOpenRouterModelCache
methods.description: Ensures the in-memory cache is populated, loading from disk or triggering an API fetch if necessary.

methods.name: loadOpenRouterModelCapabilities
methods.description: Loads capabilities for a specific model, waiting for cache population if needed.

methods.name: getOpenRouterModelCapabilities
methods.description: Retrieves cached capabilities for a model, triggering a background refresh if not found.
